key.name: folder
key.description: Folder containing the wallpapers shown in the picker. ~ and $HOME are expanded. Leave empty to show no wallpapers.

key.name: include-subfolders
key.description: Also list image files inside subfolders of the wallpaper folder.

key.name: instant-preview
key.description: Apply the focused wallpaper live while browsing the picker; the previous wallpaper is restored when the picker closes without choosing.

key.name: picker-theme
key.description: Presentation used by the wallpaper picker: 0 = Omarchy carousel, 1 = Character Select roster, 2 = Polaroid vintage, 3 = Comic Strip.

key.name: picker-polaroid-cols
key.description: How many polaroids fit in one row before the board slides horizontally.

key.name: picker-polaroid-rows
key.description: How many polaroid rows are visible on screen at once.

key.name: show-picker
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the full-screen wallpaper picker.

key.name: show-tray-icon
key.summary: Show icon in the top panel
key.description: Whether the tray icon that opens the wallpaper picker is shown in the top panel.

key.name: show-file-name
key.summary: Show file names on image items
key.description: When enabled, the file name is shown as a caption below each image item in the picker themes that place items in a row or grid (non-omarchy). The top header never shows the file name or instructions regardless of this setting.
